scenes.subject: A sea of people at night, each lit by their own phone's glow — the crowd of users, wide and high.
One person alone at a desk, face lit by a chat window — the count becomes people.
The same figure closer, the screen's glow reflecting them — the mirror.
A conversation mid-flow, session after session stacking upward like pages.
The chat window as a glass cabinet on a distant server wall, your sessions filed inside it.
A wooden desk from above: handwritten instruction cards, an open notebook, a stack of folders.
The same desk tighter: notebook and folders in warm light.
A small lit digital home at dusk, its door swinging shut.
The same home dark, windows black, door shut — holds through the designed silence (C-1a).
An emptied rented room, bare walls, a set of keys left on the counter.
A vast luminous engine core in a dark hall, light pouring from it.
Hands at a keyboard in warm light; the conversation's words becoming visible notes drifting toward a forming layer.
The three sources as objects on a workbench: instruction cards, feedback notes with corrections marked, preference dials.
scenes.subject_clarification_2026-10-28: The three sources as objects on a workbench: instruction cards with blank faces, feedback notes corrected with marks only (red check marks, underlines, strike-through strokes, abstract ink marks that never form letters or words), preference dials.

scenes.subject: The materials distilled: a clear, ordered, glowing layer of condensed pages settling into place.
The finished layer as one object between two doorways — a lit corporate tower, a warm home.
Inside a bright platform facility, a system assembling a layer for a user.
Streams of a user's own past sessions flowing from their devices into the platform's builder.
The finished layer behind glass in the platform's vault.
A home desk at night; the owner building the same layer themselves, tools in hand.
The same desk; the engine beneath the layer swapped for a different one, the layer untouched.
A split frame: the same warm light of intelligence glowing in two different homes.
A row of identical glowing engines, each wearing a blank paper tag shape (no readable words).
The owner's layer at home, its light moving outward.
Objects being placed on the owner's shelves, remaining there in calm light.
The layer richer than before: a fresh session note pinned to it, its edge honed bright.
The same layer matured — a tended workbench after seasons: organized, deep, alive with use.
The layer kept like a deed in the owner's own strongbox at home, the key in the owner's hand.
The layer spread open on the owner's screen, every page readable, no locks anywhere.
Hands opening the layer, reading a page, editing a line with a pen.
The same desk; beside it an open gate, no permission desk, no guard.
The layer unrolled as a legible map across the desk, the owner studying it.
The owner's hands mid-build, the layer half-assembled under warm work light.
Evening calm: the owner glancing over the finished layer at home, a watchful light over it — holds through the tail (C-1b).
